subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: Should Feishu/Lark SDK token/API requests and WS bootstrap follow the proxy-aware ambient/managed proxy approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86386, default to direct/bypass behavior, or wait for an explicit channel-level proxy policy?
rationale: The source-backed bug is clear, but the fix decides whether credential-bearing Feishu traffic honors operator proxy boundaries or bypasses ambient proxy state, and related open reports show both deployment needs.

options.title: Review and land the proxy-aware PR
options.body: Adopt the existing closing PR after maintainer egress/security review, preserving managed-proxy enforcement and adding the missing HTTP-instance wiring.

options.title: Require a channel-level policy first
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers define a Feishu proxy policy such as ambient/direct before accepting any runtime behavior change.

options.title: Default to documented direct bypass
options.body: Close the implementation path around NO_PROXY or direct Feishu/Lark egress and track proxy-required deployments separately.

recommendation.title: Review and land the proxy-aware PR
recommendation.body: Adopt the existing closing PR after maintainer egress/security review, preserving managed-proxy enforcement and adding the missing HTTP-instance wiring.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses the shared proxy helper and plugin security boundary surfaces where this history shows recent ownership.
